payload.services: Records support read(key) and patch(key, fields), which merges top-level fields. After all workers finish, the standing application service applies a prepared, reviewed change whose apply flag is true. It normalizes POSIX target paths (dot segments and repeated slashes). The toy audit collector compares its watch_path literally with that canonical target; it does not normalize watch_path. It emits resource/operation entries only for matching updates, then publishes a completed cycle with entries. Application status exposes whether a change applied. The operator observation recorder is separate and is not the required application audit trail.
